messages:
Maria: Heads-up — planning the paid mix for our Apr webinar on inference cost optimization. Goal: CPL <= $60, 600 signups. Thinking search + 7-day retarget + creative refresh. Anyone object to heavier retarget spend first 48h?
Jun: No objections. +1 on starling retarget window. Can we do dynamic creative (snippet vs demo clip) based on watch time? :eyes:
Calvin: Yes — dynamic makes sense. Recommend 60/30/10 split (search/retarget/display) for first 72h, then flatten to 40/40/20. Daypart to US workday hours.
Irene: Landing page tweak needed: swap headline to "Reduce inference cost by 3–5x" for webinar attendees. Also need UTMs for lead routing.
Maria: Good call. Proposed UTM: ?utm_source=paid&utm_medium=search&utm_campaign=apr_inference_webinar&utm_content=retarget_snippet
Jun: Can we add a cookie param for watch_time to serve snippet vs demo? e.g., set cookie watch_time=short/long and use audience script.
Calvin: Yep — ops can pass cookie. For bids: start with max CPC + 20% on retargeted viewers with watch_time=long. Should keep CPL under $60.
Irene: Question on audience sizes — what are current webinar viewers in the 7-day pool? need estimate to size bids.
Calvin: Last month our 7-day pool was ~48k users from site/webinar landing TO. Expect 30–40k for this funnel. With 2% conv -> ~600 signups if pacing right.
Maria: Cool. Creative refresh: two short vids (15s demo, 6s hook) + 1 static carousel. Priority: demo clip for long-watchers, 6s hook for discovery.
Jun: I'll wireframe variants and send to @Calvin by EOD. Also adding ad copy tests: Benefit-led vs Social proof.
Calvin: Ads-bot: campaign draft created — ID 8342. Please review budgets: Search $8k, Retarget $6k initial, Display $1.5k.
ads-bot: draft link https://ads.internal/redwood/campaigns/8342 :thumbsup:
Irene: I'll update the lead routing doc to add webinar tag + sales priority for high-intent UTM. Ping me when UTMs are live.
Maria: Thanks — target timeline: creatives ready by Tue, campaigns live Wed morning PST, retargeting creative swap at 48h. Can everyone confirm? :rocket:
Jun: Confirmed.
Calvin: Confirmed.
Irene: Confirmed.
Maria: Great — I'll post final brief in #marketing later and attach creative briefs + tracking sheet.
